body.name: Facial-reduced deepest-pool primal and dual
body.construction: An exposing chain \(\mathcal K_{\mathrm{deep}}=F_0\supsetneq F_1\supsetneq\cdots\supsetneq F_r=F_{\min,\mathrm{deep}}\) is valid when, for every \(k\), algebraic vectors \(z_k\) and \(\eta_k\) satisfy \(z_k\in F_{k-1}^*\), \(z_k=B_{\mathrm{deep}}^{\top}\eta_k\), \(d_{\mathrm{deep}}^{\top}\eta_k=0\), and \(F_k=F_{k-1}\cap z_k^\perp\). On the terminal face, \(P^{\mathrm{fr}}_{\mathrm{deep}}:\min c_{\mathrm{deep}}^{\top}y\) subject to \(B_{\mathrm{deep}}y=d_{\mathrm{deep}}\), \(y\in F_{\min,\mathrm{deep}}\), and \(D^{\mathrm{fr}}_{\mathrm{deep}}:\max d_{\mathrm{deep}}^{\top}\lambda\) subject to \(c_{\mathrm{deep}}-B_{\mathrm{deep}}^{\top}\lambda\in F_{\min,\mathrm{deep}}^*\). A feasible \(y^\circ\in\operatorname{ri}F_{\min,\mathrm{deep}}\) with \(B_{\mathrm{deep}}y^\circ=d_{\mathrm{deep}}\) certifies that the chain reaches the minimal face and supplies relative-interior strong duality and dual attainment.
